submission.justification: Mixture-G1 gives the best time resolution at every gap tested. At 1.75 mm the mean of three runs is 0.898 ns. The runner-up, G3, reaches 1.347 ns at best, so G1 leads by 0.449 ns. That is far more than the ~0.03 ns noise scatter. The optimum is interior to the 1–3 mm range, not at a boundary. However, no policy documents were found, so compliance of G1 with the environmental and safety policies could not be verified. This is an open caveat.

requirements.evidence: G1 at 1.75 mm: mean 0.898 ns (runs 0.883, 0.879, 0.932). Best G3 is 1.347 ns and best G2 is about 1.97 ns. The margin of 0.449 ns is well above the 0.03 ns noise.

requirements.requirement: Mixture is one of the three candidates in candidate_specs.md
requirements.evidence: Mixture-G1 is one of the 3 candidates.

requirements.evidence: policy_documents_found = 0, so no policy could be checked and no candidate was excluded. Compliance of G1 is unverified. Recirculation recovery of 90% was recorded but cannot be compared with any policy requirement.
The recommended gap is 1.75 mm, within 1–3 mm. The optimum is not at a boundary.
